sources.title: GitHub - pinheiro-dataworks/claim-sight: Vehicle-damage triage ...
sources.snippet: ClaimSight is a binary vehicle-damage classifier for auto-insurance claim triage: given a photo, it predicts damaged vs whole, explains the prediction with a Grad-CAM heatmap, and serves it all behind a tested FastAPI endpoint — with a single deterministic preprocessing function shared by training, evaluation, and serving so there is no training/serving skew.

sources.title: ClaimSight — Vehicle Damage Triage System
sources.snippet: ClaimSight is a binary vehicle-damage classifier for auto-insurance claim triage — deterministic OpenCV pipeline, ResNet50 transfer learning, Grad-CAM explainability, and a served FastAPI endpoint. 94.3% validation accuracy, ROC-AUC 0.986.
